tasks.title: Setup Test Environment for Supernoba Lambda Functions
tasks.description: Create local testing environment with AWS SAM CLI, mock services (DynamoDB, Redis, PostgreSQL), and test data setup
tasks.details: Install AWS SAM CLI, create samconfig.toml with local Docker emulation. Use LocalStack for DynamoDB/Redis/SQS emulation. Setup test PostgreSQL container with pgAdmin. Create initial test data: 5 symbols, 3 admin users, 2 regular users. Configure environment variables for all 3 Lambda functions.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify SAM local invoke works for all functions. Check LocalStack services running: sam local start-api --port 3000. Confirm test data loaded via pgAdmin/DynamoDB console.

tasks.title: Test Symbol-Admin Public APIs - GET /symbols endpoints
tasks.description: Test public symbol list and detail retrieval without authentication
tasks.details: Use curl or Postman: GET /symbols (expect 200 with list), GET /symbols/valid-symbol (200 with details), GET /symbols/invalid-symbol (404), GET /symbols?q=test (search param). Verify response format matches PRD expectations.
tasks.testStrategy: sam local invoke SymbolAdminFunction -e events/get-symbols.json && sam local invoke SymbolAdminFunction -e events/get-symbol-detail.json. Assert status codes and response structure using pytest with Arrange-Act-Assert.

tasks.title: Test Symbol-Admin Symbol Registration and Activation
tasks.description: Test POST /symbols with action=listing and action=activate requiring admin auth
tasks.details: Mock admin JWT token. Test: valid listing (symbol 2-20 chars alphanumeric), duplicate symbol (409), missing fields (400), activate success with Redis active:symbols sync. Use moto.mock_dynamodb() for DynamoDB mocking.
tasks.testStrategy: pytest with @pytest.fixture mock_dynamodb. Test cases: valid_registration(), duplicate_symbol(), invalid_symbol_length(), missing_required_fields(). Verify Redis key via redis-py.

tasks.title: Test Symbol-Admin Symbol Update and Delete Operations
tasks.description: Test PUT /symbols/{symbol} and DELETE /symbols/{symbol} with Redis sync and SQS cleanup
tasks.details: Test PUT updates with status change (verify Redis sync), DELETE adds to deleted:symbols Redis set and sends SQS message, POST restore from deleted state. Mock SQS with moto.mock_sqs().
tasks.testStrategy: Integration test with LocalStack SQS. Verify: status updates in DB, Redis sets populated, SQS message queue length +1 after delete.

tasks.title: Test Symbol-Admin Utility APIs - Sync and CleanChart
tasks.description: Test POST /sync Redis synchronization and POST /cleanChart data cleanup
tasks.details: POST /sync: verify active:symbols Redis set count matches DB. POST /cleanChart: verify PostgreSQL candle_history DELETE and Redis candle cache cleanup. Use testcontainers-python for PostgreSQL.
tasks.testStrategy: Before/after counts: DB rows, Redis keys. sam local invoke with custom events. Assert candle_history table empty after cleanChart.

tasks.title: Test Admin-Core Authentication API
tasks.description: Test GET /auth admin permission check by userId and twitterUsername
tasks.details: Test admin user (true), non-admin (false), invalid userId (false). Mock Cognito JWT verification. Test both lookup methods.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests with mocked JWT decoder. Integration test with sam local invoke. Verify DynamoDB admin_users table queries.

tasks.title: Test Admin-Core User Management APIs
tasks.description: Test GET /users list with pagination, search, status filter and GET /users/{userId} detail
tasks.details: Test pagination (?page=1&limit=10), search (?q=username), status filter (?status=active). Detail includes wallets, orders, holdings nested objects.
tasks.testStrategy: pytest with multiple query param combinations. Verify response pagination metadata and nested objects present.

tasks.title: Test Admin-Core User Action APIs
tasks.description: Test user suspend/unsuspend, setBalance, setHolding with audit logging
tasks.details: POST suspend (Redis user:suspended key), unsuspend (key delete), setBalance (wallet update), setHolding (holdings table). Verify audit_log table entries.
tasks.testStrategy: Before/after Redis key checks, DB table verification. Test audit log INSERT with correct timestamps and action details.

tasks.title: Test Admin-Core Settings Management APIs
tasks.description: Test site and tickerTape settings CRUD with validation and cache invalidation
tasks.details: GET/PUT /settings/site (validate default symbol exists), GET/PUT /settings/tickerTape. Verify cache invalidation on Redis.
tasks.testStrategy: Test invalid symbol setting returns 400. Verify Redis cache keys cleared after PUT. Check settings table updates.

tasks.title: Test Admin-Core Alerts API
tasks.description: Test GET /alerts retrieving ENGINE_ERRORS, MISSING_PRICE_DATA, MARKET_MAKER_RUNNING alerts
tasks.details: Seed alerts table with test data for all 3 types. Verify pagination and filtering works.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify specific alert types returned in response. Test empty alerts list scenario.

tasks.title: Test Auth X OAuth Initialization Flow
tasks.description: Test GET /auth/x/init generating OAuth URL with PKCE and state storage
tasks.details: Verify response contains X OAuth URL, state saved in DynamoDB, PKCE code_challenge generated correctly.
tasks.testStrategy: Mock crypto.randomBytes for PKCE. Verify DynamoDB oauth_states table INSERT. Check callback URL format.

tasks.title: Test Auth X OAuth Callback Processing
tasks.description: Test GET /auth/x/callback handling OAuth response and token exchange
tasks.details: Mock X OAuth response. Test state validation, code verification, token exchange with X API. Store access/refresh tokens.
tasks.testStrategy: Integration test with mocked X API responses. Verify tokens stored in DynamoDB users table.

tasks.title: Test Auth User Initialization Flow
tasks.description: Test GET/POST /auth/init for new/existing users with wallet creation and welcome bonus
tasks.details: GET /auth/init status check, POST creates user-cache, wallets records, applies welcomeBonus. Test idempotency.
tasks.testStrategy: Test new user flow end-to-end. Verify wallets table INSERT, user-cache created, bonus applied to balance.

tasks.title: Test Auth Token Refresh API
tasks.description: Test POST /auth/x/refresh with valid/expired refresh tokens
tasks.details: Valid refresh → new access/idToken. Expired refresh → 401 error. Mock Cognito token validation.
tasks.testStrategy: Test token expiry scenarios. Verify new tokens issued with correct expiry times.

tasks.title: Test Security, Authorization, and Error Handling
tasks.description: Test 401/404/400/500 responses, CORS headers, injection protection across all APIs
tasks.details: Test unauth admin calls (401), invalid JSON (400), non-existent resources (404), SQL/symbol injection attempts. Verify CORS headers present.
tasks.testStrategy: Security scan with curl fuzzing. Verify all error responses follow standard format. Check symbol regex validation.

tasks.title: Test Performance, Connection Management, and Frontend Integration
tasks.description: Test PostgreSQL pool, Redis stability, concurrent requests, and frontend compatibility
tasks.details: Load test 100 concurrent requests. Verify 30s idle timeout disconnects. Test SystemSettingsService.js integration with /auth/init.
tasks.testStrategy: Apache Bench (ab -n 100 -c 10), monitor connection pools. Frontend e2e test with Cypress calling new endpoints.
